label: Where did you get my number?
answer: We got your number from {source}, on {source_date}. If you do not want calls from us, tell me and I will stop them right away.
fallback: I am sorry, I do not have that detail in front of me. If you do not want calls from us, tell me and I will stop them right away.

label: I never gave you my number
answer: I am sorry about that. It may have been entered by mistake. Shall I take your number off our list, so we do not call again?

label: Who are you? Which institute?
answer: I am {me}, calling from {institute}. You can call our office or visit us any time to check.

label: Is this a sales call?
answer: Yes, it is. I am calling to tell you about {institute}. If it is not useful for you, just tell me and I will not call again.

label: I am busy, call later
answer: Sorry to call at a busy time. When is a good time to call you back? I will call you then.

label: How long will this take?
answer: Just two minutes. If now is not a good time, I can call you later.

label: Send the details on WhatsApp
answer: Sure. Shall I send them on WhatsApp to this number? I will send them right after this call.

label: Do not call me again
answer: I am sorry for the trouble. I will mark your number as do not call, and we will not call you again. Have a good day.

label: I am on the DND list
answer: I am sorry. I will mark your number as do not call right now, and we will not call you again. Have a good day.

label: How much is the fee?
answer: Let me tell you the exact fee, so there is no confusion. I can also send the fee details on WhatsApp.
check: Point callers to the fee facts of this campaign (the fee list the admin adds to the script), or say the fee is sent on WhatsApp.

label: Is there a discount?
answer: I cannot promise a discount on the call. Let me tell you exactly what {institute} offers right now.
check: Add the discounts or scholarships your institute really offers, with who can get them and the end date, or write: "There is no discount right now."

label: Is this a fraud or spam call?
answer: You are right to be careful. We will never ask for an OTP or bank details. You can check us by calling the {institute} office number on our website, or by visiting us.
check: Add your office landline and website, if callers should say them.

label: Do you need my OTP or bank details?
answer: No. We will never ask for an OTP, PIN, password or bank details on a call. Please do not share them with anyone.

label: Can you speak in Hindi?
answer: Ji, bilkul. Hindi mein baat karte hain. (If you cannot speak Hindi well: Sorry, I will ask a colleague to call you back in Hindi. When is a good time?)

label: I will ask my husband, wife or parents
answer: Of course, please talk to them. When can I call back? I can also speak to them directly, if you like.

label: Can you call the other parent?
answer: Sure. Which number should I call, and when is a good time? I will note it.

label: Already joined somewhere else
answer: Thank you for telling me. All the best! If you ever need us, you can call {institute}.

label: You have the wrong number
answer: Sorry to trouble you. I will correct our records. Have a good day.

label: Where is the institute?
answer: Let me tell you the address. I can also send the location on WhatsApp.
check: Add your address with a well-known landmark nearby.

label: Can I speak to someone senior?
answer: Sure. I will pass your request to the office, and someone senior will call you. When is a good time?

label: Which number can I call you back on?
answer: You can call the {institute} office number. I can send it to you on WhatsApp.
check: Add the office number callers should give, and its hours.
